messages:
Mia Chen: kicking off a mini-scan for hetero-quant ensemble (mix of int4/nf4 per-layer) on a 1% production slice. goal: fast detect quality delta + latency tail changes. will run ~20k requests across slices.
Sam K: which traffic slices are we using? and what's the auto-fallback rule?
Mia Chen: slices: conv-support, finance-qa, short-chat. config below. fallback guard is automatic rollback if delta_mrr <= -0.015 OR hallucination_rate increases by >0.01 absolute for 5m rolling.
Mia Chen: ```
variant: hetero-quant-ens-v1
traffic: 1%
slices: ["conv-support","finance-qa","short-chat"]
metrics: [mrr, latency_p95, hallucination_rate, token_cost]
auto_fallback: {window: 5m, thresholds: {mrr_drop: 0.015, halluc_abs: 0.01}}
report_interval: 60s
```
Jordan L: noted. will attach the sample set id to the run for traceability.
deploy-bot: hetero-quant-ens-v1 shadow traffic started @ 3770011250 (1% slice) :rocket:
Neil P: early smoke after 2k requests: conv-support MRR delta = -0.004, latency_p95 +6ms, hallucination +0.002. finance-qa: MRR -0.018, hallucination +0.012.
Sam K: finance-qa looks above the threshold (mrr drop >1.5% and halluc +1.2%). can we get per-example diffs for the finance-qa slice?
Mia Chen: pulling the diff set. triggering a paused auto-fallback check (we still allow human override).
Arun: attaching quick delta sample: ``[id: fqa-2026-377001]`` top failure patterns look like entity truncation on long numeric lists.
Mia Chen: thanks @Arun. seems like quantized layers near numeric extraction are noisy. this explains finance-qa regressions.
qa-bot: quick-eval: token_cost -8%, latency_p95 +4.5%, overall quality score -1.9% on finance-qa.
Sam K: given the policy, this should have triggered auto-fallback. why didn't it?
Mia Chen: our implementation waits for sustained window of 5m with contiguous violation; current failures are bursty within 2-3m window. auto-fallback not triggered yet.
Neil P: propose a short-circuit rule for high-severity slices: if mrr_drop > 0.02 OR halluc_abs > 0.02 at any point -> instant fallback. finance-qa could be high-severity.
Jordan L: agree. we should whitelist regulated slices (finance, healthcare) for stricter instant-fallback thresholds.
Mia Chen: temporary action: pausing rollforward on finance-qa and routing that slice back to baseline variant. leaving short-chat and conv-support at shadow -> continue scan.
deploy-bot: routing rule applied: finance-qa -> baseline-v2 at 3770011280 :white_check_mark:
Arun: for next run, can we try hybrid patch: keep most aggressive quant but restore fp32 for layers 5-7 (the numeric heads)? quick patch seemed to fix entity truncation in offline tests.
Mia Chen: yes. we'll create hetero-quant-ens-v1a with fp32 heads and run a 0.5% sanity pass against finance-qa.
Sam K: also add a small monitoring tweak: alert if a single slice has >1.5% mrr drop even if not sustained for 5m. that would have caught this earlier.
Mia Chen: noted. filing follow-up: will update rollout config and add an incident-light note to the runbook.
Neil P: thanks. small ask: export full per-example diffs for the paused window (2k-6k requests) and put in the run artifact bucket. I'll run comp-slice analysis.
Mia Chen: done — artifacts uploaded to s3://ri-mini-scan/3770011223/ (link in thread).
Jordan L: can someone set an ops ticket to add regulated-slice instantaneous-fallback to policy? low effort, high safety.
Mia Chen: filing now. cc @arun @Sam K
Sam K: glhf. :thumbsup:
